results.controlIntent: Audit records from [Assignment: organization-defined system components] are compiled into a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail time-correlated to within [Assignment: organization-defined level of tolerance for the relationship between time stamps of individual records in the audit trail].

judgment.rationale:
AU-12(1).v2 requires that audit records from all relevant system components be compiled into a time-correlated, system-wide audit trail. Evidence from this session reveals two issues:

1. **Partial coverage — missing registry record for hotfix deployment:** The CloudTrail UpdateEndpoint event (b09c8d76) on 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z documents a live endpoint change ("churn-predictor-v1-hotfix"), but no corresponding model registry entry exists for this version. This breaks the cross-source audit trail: one component (CloudTrail/endpoint) recorded the event while another (model registry) did not. A complete, system-wide audit trail requires both sources to capture correlated records for every significant lifecycle event.

2. **Timestamps are present and internally consistent where records exist:** The initial CreateEndpoint event (dd64e173, 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z) and the registry approval (fd1618a3, 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z) both carry precise UTC timestamps and are temporally ordered — the deployment occurred 2 hours after approval. This portion of the audit trail is time-correlated and traceable across sources.

Because the hotfix deployment on 2026-03-15 is captured in only one of the two system components (CloudTrail but not the model registry), the audit trail is incomplete and the time-correlation requirement cannot be fully satisfied for that event. The control is therefore partially satisfied.
gaps: No model registry entry exists for the 2026-03-15 hotfix deployment (churn-predictor-v1-hotfix) — human attestation or a registry search tool would be needed to confirm whether a registry record was created outside the current scope.

No evidence of a centralized log aggregation or SIEM configuration was available — it cannot be confirmed whether CloudTrail and SageMaker registry events are being compiled into a unified, time-correlated audit trail at the platform level (e.g., via CloudWatch Logs Insights, Athena, or a SIEM).
No clock synchronization (NTP/AWS Time Sync) configuration evidence was retrieved — cannot formally verify that timestamps across components meet an organization-defined tolerance threshold.
